title: Wren and the Postcard
author: Emrys Dunmore
blurb: Casper Blackwood, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
